question: What is the cosmic egg named?
premises: Even in the Shiva principle, kalā-union is declared.
The cosmic egg is named the cause of world-division establishment.
inference: Kalā-union is declared even in the Shiva principle, and the cosmic egg is named the cause of world-division establishment.
uncertainties: The exact force of yato@taḥ as a causal connector is unclear.
The precise referent and scope of aṇḍaṃ are not specified.
kalāsaṃgati may mean union of kalās or association with kalās.
plain_english: Because even in the Shiva principle a union of kalās is declared; and the cosmic egg is named the cause of the establishment of world-divisions.
